text:
The amphibian that can change its color to blend with the environment is the chameleon.

The German sentence "Geduld ist eine bittere Pflanze, aber sie trägt süße Früchte" translates to Mandarin as: 耐心是一种苦涩的植物，但它结出甜美的果实。

This proverb conveys the underlying idea that while the process of waiting or enduring hardship (patience) may feel difficult or unpleasant in the moment (like a bitter plant), the eventual outcome or reward (the sweet fruits) makes the struggle worthwhile. It emphasizes the value of perseverance and long-term thinking over immediate gratification.
